تمتحنون (form VIII)
# تَمْتَحِنُونَ (tamtaḥinūna) /tam.ta.ħi.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
# تُمْتَحَنُونَ (tumtaḥanūna) /tum.ta.ħa.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
